title: Prefetch workers inherit the cutoff verdicts the command thread checked and persisted
description: Prefetch workers inherit the cutoff verdicts the command thread checked and persisted
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-136 says whether a workflow-v1 change existed at the trusted pre-v2 cutoff is read from the cutoff tree once per command and kept in the persistent read cache; prefetch workers each read the cutoff tree again and kept nothing, because only the command thread reaches the cache (#978)
acceptance_criteria: after a cold archived status whose archives are checked by prefetch workers, the persistent read cache holds the cutoff verdict of every workflow-v1 archive; verdicts and refusals are unchanged
